v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Proprio de Tempore

text.la: In illa die * stillábunt montes dulcédinem, et colles fluent lac et mel, allelúia.
text.en: In that day * the mountains shall drop down sweet wine, and the hills shall flow with milk and honey. Alleluia.

text.la: Iucundáre, * fília Sion, et exsúlta satis, fília Ierúsalem, allelúia.
text.en: Sing, O daughter of Zion, * and rejoice with all the heart, O daughter of Jerusalem. Alleluia.

text.la: Ecce Dóminus véniet, * et omnes Sancti eius cum eo: et erit in die illa lux magna, allelúia.
text.en: Behold, the Lord shall come, * and all His saints with Him; and it shall come to pass in that day that the light shall be great. Alleluia.

text.la: Omnes sitiéntes, * veníte ad aquas: quǽrite Dóminum, dum inveníri potest, allelúia.
text.en: Lo, every one that thirsteth * come ye to the waters: seek ye the Lord while He may be found. Alleluia.

text.la: Ecce véniet * Prophéta magnus, et ipse renovábit Ierúsalem, allelúia.
text.en: Behold, a great Prophet * shall arise, and He shall build up a new Jerusalem. Alleluia.

text.la: Fratres: Hora est iam nos de somno súrgere: nunc enim própior est nostra salus, quam cum credídimus.
text.en: And that knowing the season; that it is now the hour for us to rise from sleep. For now our salvation is nearer than when we believed.

v.la: Vox clamántis in desérto: Paráte viam Dómini.
v.en: A voice of one crying in the wilderness: Prepare the way of the Lord.

text.la: Spíritus Sanctus * in te descéndet, María: ne tímeas, habébis in útero Fílium Dei, allelúia.
text.en: The Holy Ghost shall come upon thee, * O Mary; fear not, thou shalt bear in thy womb the Son of God. Alleluia.

text.la: Excita, quǽsumus, Dómine, poténtiam tuam, et veni: ut ab imminéntibus peccatórum nostrórum perículis, te mereámur protegénte éripi, te liberánte salvári:
text.en: Stir up, O Lord, we pray thee, thy strength, and come among us, that whereas through our sins and wickedness we do justly apprehend thy wrathful judgments hanging over us, thy bountiful grace and mercy may speedily help and deliver us;
